answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nadir of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, weighted by independent path length, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A fable of per-task receipts records who did what, and the basalt of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
